description: def main(), do: Enum.each(JSON.decode!("[]"), fn r -> Enum.join(r) end) reports error[spec/violation]: call to join/1 violates its @spec for arguments ({any, any}); the declared domain is ([a0_e]). elixir prints :ok. Same with Enum.join(r, "."). Visible once fz-sc8.139 is in: an element drawn from an any enumerable includes the Map impl's {key, value} pair. Cause (inferred): Enum.join's spec domain is a list where Elixir accepts any enumerable (Enum.join(%{}, ".") is ""). Check the other Enum functions specced on a list for the same narrowing. Repro: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz-xxd13-build/d6960461-b7a2-4585-a9e7-9f2477e57ee2/scratchpad/land/join_spec_min.fz; 5-line variant /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz-xxd13-build/d6960461-b7a2-4585-a9e7-9f2477e57ee2/scratchpad/census/panic_min.fz.
